en.summary: Echoes of Aincrad is a Sword Art Online action RPG developed by Game Studio Inc. and published by Bandai Namco, released July 9–10, 2026 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC. Unlike most prior Sword Art Online games, it drops the player into the original death-game premise as a fully customizable, original protagonist rather than Kirito, tasked with surviving a permanent Death Game mode as they climb the floating castle of Aincrad's first two floors alongside returning characters like Argo, Kirito, and Asuna.

guideSections.title: Real-Time Combat & Weapon Builds
guideSections.description: Combat is a real-time action RPG system built around timing, positioning, and resource management, with different weapon types pushing players toward different playstyles — fast, precise builds versus heavier, more defensive setups — and progression driven by gear upgrades and skill growth as Aincrad's floors get harder.

guideSections.title: Post-Launch Expansion
guideSections.description: An expansion DLC adding a side story and new companions is planned for release between October and December 2026, included with the Deluxe, Ultimate, and Aincrad Editions or purchasable separately.
